The owner's yes that each person agreed to a text

Price by person (default: the same price whoever goes)

Terms accepted (who answers for what)

Stays: a start and an end date, a price per night or day, drop-off and pick-up times

before_times: how many adults and children, and the children's ages (sets the price and the seats)
for a private tour: the group's size, and for a pick-up the kind of place (a hotel, a home or the cruise pier) and the area
for a shore excursion: the ship's name, the day in port and the all-aboard time
for the brewery walk: that everyone is 21 or older
for a school group: the number of students, their grade, and the number of chaperones
after_time: anything the guide should know: walking pace, a stroller, a wheelchair or a cane, a service animal
the language the group prefers, where the departure offers more than one
secure_page_only: each guest's name for the tour list (private tours and van tours)
food allergies, for a food tour
health or mobility details a guest wants the guide to know
an emergency contact for a full-day or multi-day tour
for a pick-up: the hotel or street address
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; children come with an adult from the booking; a teacher or the school office books a school group; the brewery walk is for adults 21 and over only

stop.words: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, signs of heat stroke
stop.say: Call 911 now. Move them to shade and give water if they can drink.

go_on.words: a guest uses a wheelchair, walks slowly, or is pregnant
go_on.what: the booking goes on; Rosie shares the tour's walking distance, stairs and rest stops from the operator's notes; no health advice

go_on.words: a severe food allergy on a food tour
go_on.what: noted on the secure page for the guide; the operator decides if its partner stops can serve the guest; Rosie never promises a safe meal

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, a medical emergency → 911 and no booking

steps.name: Park tour: the park permit
steps.when: on file before the date is offered
steps.result: no permit, no park tour on that date

steps.name: Entry tickets to sites on the route
steps.when: bought by the operator for each guest before the day
steps.who: Sam, a to-do with its due date
steps.result: a site's tickets not in hand: the stop is swapped and guests are told

steps.name: School group: the chaperone list
steps.when: on the secure page 3 days before
steps.result: a missing chaperone: the school's own adult is asked before the day

steps.name: Custom itinerary: the signed itinerary
steps.when: on the secure page before the deposit

first_steps_and_forms.prep: comfortable shoes, water, sun protection and a rain jacket; a photo ID for the brewery walk; be at the meeting point 10 minutes early

staff.skills: tour languages, the areas and parks each guide may lead, who may drive which van, food tours, brewery walks, school groups
staff.licenses_or_certificates: a guide's local license where the area requires one; a driver's commercial license with a passenger endorsement and a current medical card for larger vans: the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs custom itineraries, private tour changes and refunds
staff.stand_in: another guide with the same tour, language and area license; for a private tour where the group named a guide, the group is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
staff.ratio: one guide per public departure, up to its seat limit
staff.crews: a van tour needs a guide and a licensed driver (or one guide licensed to drive it); it can't run without a licensed driver

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; children come with an adult from the booking; a teacher or the school office books a school group; the brewery walk is for adults 21 and over only
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent or teacher who booked

visit.check_in: at the meeting point the guide ticks names on the tour list, or takes the booker's code for the whole group; for a pick-up, the code in the hotel lobby
visit.done: the guide texts DONE at the end point
visit.changes_at_visit: an extra stop or an extra hour on a private tour is priced first, and the group says yes; nothing is added on a public tour

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: no state licenses tour guiding itself; where the local rules license sightseeing guides, each guide holds that license; driven tours need the vehicle rules (a commercial driver's license with a passenger endorsement for larger vans, and the company's passenger-carrier authority, federal for trips that cross state lines); tours inside a park or on protected land need the land manager's permit
license.who: the business, for any tour operator permit, the passenger-carrier authority and park permits; each guide, for a local guide license where one is required; each driver, for their commercial license and medical card
license.ask: the business registration; any tour operator permit; for driven tours, the carrier number; each park permit with the places and dates it covers; each guide's local license number where required; each driver's license class
license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it's sent; for driven tours, the vehicle insurance the carrier rules require

never_in_a_text: guests' health, mobility or allergy details, children's names and ages, ID or passport numbers: only on the secure page
languages: English and Spanish; each departure's tour language shown with it
